svg.title: 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing and gut microbiota bioinformatics workflow
svg.desc: Workflow for a 2 × 2 vitamin A and methylmercury study. Sequential 16S rRNA gene sequencing, DADA2 processing, SILVA taxonomy, and data curation lead to two parallel lanes: taxonomic ecology and PICRUSt2 predicted functional profiles. PICRUSt2 feeds four independent analyses, including KO PCA, predicted KEGG pathway testing, scripted KO heatmaps with manual map coloring and composites, and predicted mercury-related orthologs. Border patterns identify scripted, reconstructed, hybrid, and manual steps.
